`jobs-0.29.10.json` was generated by the actual `v0.29.10` bundled MCP server from the release tag, with two completed fake CLI tasks and detached runners disabled. Only the temporary fixture working-directory prefix was replaced with `/fixture/project`. The records exercise the production version-2 on-disk shape, session ids, lineage, arguments, workdirs and completion timestamps.

Upgrade tests preserve every original field except the explicit ownership and supervisor-address changes, retain archive/run/config bytes, verify the pre-migration backup and idempotency, and inject publication failure before replacement.

`bridge-0.29.10.sql` exports the exact version-6 schema from the database produced by that released server. Tests populate representative messages, archives, decisions, history, session bindings and peer names, compare all original table records after migration, and verify rollback and downgrade rejection.
